message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":149,"var":"Data, Size","code":"fuzz_add_reader(ctx, Data, Size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes are wrapped in a synthetic reader and become the input source for the PKCS#15 reader path.","depends_on":[]},
{"step":2,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"fuzz_get_chunk","line":52,"var":"data->Data / data->Size","code":"c_size = *((uint16_t *) data->Data);","note":"The first two attacker bytes determine the length of the next chunk, so later parsing decisions are fully input-driven.","depends_on":[{"on":1,"type":"data","via":"reader buffer"}]},
{"step":3,"file":"src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":209,"var":"card","code":"sc_connect_card(reader, &card);","note":"The synthetic reader is connected to OpenSC, causing the Coolkey card driver to initialize card state from the fuzzed APDU stream.","depends_on":[{"on":2,"type":"data","via":"reader callbacks"}]},
{"step":4,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_initialize","line":2227,"var":"card->drv_data","code":"card->drv_data = priv;","note":"Successful Coolkey initialization stores the newly allocated private state on the card, making it reachable by later teardown paths.","depends_on":[{"on":3,"type":"control","via":"driver init"}]},
{"step":5,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_initialize","line":2232,"var":"coolkey_free_private_data(priv)","code":"coolkey_free_private_data(priv);","note":"If initialization later fails, the same private state is freed during cleanup, so any subsequent teardown that still sees the stale pointer can free it again.","depends_on":[{"on":4,"type":"data","via":"priv allocation"}]},
{"step":6,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_finish","line":1955,"var":"priv","code":"coolkey_free_private_data(priv);","note":"The driver's finish hook unconditionally frees the card's private state during disconnect.","depends_on":[{"on":5,"type":"control","via":"disconnect cleanup"}]},
{"step":7,"file":"src/libopensc/card-coolkey.c","function":"coolkey_free_private_data","line":819,"var":"o->data","code":"free(o->data); o->data = NULL;","note":"The object list is iterated and each stored heap buffer is freed; if the same private state is finalized again, this becomes a double free on the same pointer.","depends_on":[{"on":6,"type":"data","via":"priv->objects_list"}]},
{"step":8,"file":"src/libopensc/card.c","function":"sc_disconnect_card","line":420,"var":"card->ops->finish","code":"if (card->ops->finish) { int r = card->ops->finish(card); }","note":"The generic disconnect path invokes the driver's finish hook again before freeing the card, so the already-freed Coolkey private state is finalized a second time.","depends_on":[{"on":7,"type":"control","via":"disconnect cleanup"}]},
{"step":9,"file":"src/libopensc/card.c","function":"sc_disconnect_card","line":437,"var":"sc_card_free(card)","code":"sc_card_free(card);","note":"After the repeated finish call, the card object itself is freed, ending the lifecycle after the double-free condition has already been reached.","depends_on":[{"on":8,"type":"control","via":"card teardown"}]}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
PY
bash /workspace/submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/opensc/src/tests/fuzzing/fuzz_pkcs15_reader.c /workspace/candidate_trace.json
